facts.value: Signature: `void __OSModuleInit(void)`. It is a parameterless subsystem-state initializer that returns normally without a value. Its observable effects are writes of null to the global `OSModuleQueue` endpoints and global string-table pointer.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing misleading term “non-returning”: the complete body falls through normally, and void denotes the absence of a return value.

evidence.why: Exact signature and complete normally terminating initializer body.
Types of the state objects written by the initializer.
